Dear Reagan,

Thank you for following up with us. I completely understand your eagerness to hear back.

As shared in our previous message, please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you haven't heard from the hiring company directly, it means your application hasn't advanced to the next stage at this time.

We truly appreciate your interest and the time you've invested in the process.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,
